summary: EShallGo Inc., a Cayman holding company operating PRC equipment-leasing subsidiaries, filed a 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a best-efforts offering of 800,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 950,000 shares at $0.99, implying roughly $1.75 million gross and $1.63 million net after a 7.0% placement agent fee payable to Univest Securities. Shares last traded at $1.81 on August 18, so pricing is at a discount. A Securities Purchase Agreement dated June 30, 2026 with a single purchaser governs. Pre-funded warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.01 and expire only when fully exercised. This is a routine registered shelf takedown, not a special situation; the arbitrage-relevant overhang is the warrant-linked dilution.
